records.heading: Street Racing
records.text: Any two or more persons who engage in a speed competition on a public street, road, or highway without authorization from local governments shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Operating a Unroadworthy Vehicle
records.text: Any person who operates a vehicle that is damaged enough to see visible smoke emerging (except when driving to the nearest repair center), operates a vehicle without a visible license plate, or operates a civilian vehicle with an invalid license plate shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Illegally Tinted Windows
records.text: Any person who operates a motor vehicle while having windows tinted to a degree that prevents visibility of the vehicle's interior and/or driver from the exterior shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Unlawful Transport of Persons
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who permits any person to ride on the bumper, radiator, fender, hood, top, trunk, truck bed, or running board of such vehicle when operated upon any street or highway maintained by the state, county, or municipality shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Idling
records.text: With the exclusion of on-duty peace officers, any operator of a motor vehicle who leaves the engine on while not actively operating the motor vehicle shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Driving Without a License
records.text: Any person who operates a motor vehicle without a valid license issued by the state, suspended license, or equivalent status shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Unlawful Use of Special Equipment
records.text: Any individual or organization who operates, or causes to be operated, any motor vehicle or equipment in violation of 6 M.S.C. 4 Chapter III restrictions, including unauthorized use of emergency lights, sirens, airhorns, or restricted signal lights shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Violation of DMV Regulation
records.text: Any individual or organization who willfully violates a rule, directive, order, or regulation issued by the Mayflower Division of Motor Vehicles shall be guilty of a misdemeanor, including licensing violations, vehicle registration violations, improper equipment use, administrative noncompliance, fraud, or disruptive conduct at DMV facilities or operations.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Careless Driving
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who operates a motor vehicle without exercising reasonable care or consideration for other drivers on the roadway shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Failure to Maintain Lanes
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle operating a motor vehicle who fails to keep the vehicle within its designated lane while driving, except when changing lanes, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Failure to Yield
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who, where: a non-stationary emergency vehicle within 50 studs of the rear of their vehicle, has their emergency light and/or sirens activated; or where (b) a non-stationary amber light vehicle, that is within 50 studs of the rear of their vehicle, has their warning light activated (1) fails to move their vehicle into another lane, when travelling on a roadway with two or more lanes in the same direction, when such movement can be made with due regard for safety and traffic conditions; or (2) fails to slow down to at least 20 MPH below the posted limit, where such a decrease would not result in the vehicle coming to a stop shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Failure to Signal
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who fails to signal or indicate a change of direction at an intersection by using the appropriate turn signals, except where the vehicle does not have the proper signals, is guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Failure to Stop at a Traffic Control Sign
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who does not come to a complete stop at a traffic control sign before crossing the marked stop line, crosswalk, or before obstructing the intersection will be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Failure to Stop at a Traffic Control Device
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who does not come to a complete stop at a steady red traffic control device except after making the complete stop and turning right will be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Illegal Parking
records.text:
Any person who parks upon a curb marked with red paint, an area marked with a posted no parking sign, or with both tires of the same axle reasonably far enough upon a sidewalk, or with both tires of the same axle upon a road, or with both tires of the same axle parked upon the side of a tunnel or bridge, or by parking their vehicle in a fashion which occupies more than one parking space inside a parking lot, or by parking or leaving their vehicle on a vehicle spawner without moving it within a reasonable timeframe in a fashion that a reasonable person would construe to prevent the spawning of more vehicles, is guilty of an infraction.

A “Parking Space” shall be defined as a space in which approximately one car fits, demarcated by white lines.

A “Parking Lot” shall be defined as an area in which cars are allowed to park legally, containing one or multiple parking spaces.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Impeding Traffic
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who drives at a slow rate of speed that could/does hinder or impede the flow of traffic, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Improper Lane of Travel
records.text: Any person who operates a motor vehicle in the opposite lanes of traffic, otherwise failing to stay on the right side of the road, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Driving without Headlights
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle that fails to turn their headlights on between sunset and sunrise or during foggy conditions while the vehicle is operating on a public roadway will be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Obstruction of Traffic
records.text: Any player who intentionally prevents, or reasonably could prevent cars from passing freely along the roadways by is guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Reckless Driving
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who commits three traffic violations within a short timespan, or drives in a manner that a reasonable person would consider reckless shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Felony Reckless Driving
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who commits three traffic violations within a short timespan, or drives in a manner that could endanger the lives of persons around and other drivers on the roadway shall be guilty of a felony.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Speeding
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who exceeds a declared speed limit is guilty of speeding.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Excessive Speeding
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who exceeds the declared speed limit by 20 miles-per-hour or over shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Following too Closely
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who drives behind the operator of another vehicle close enough so that they would not be able to safely stop if the driver in front of them came to a swift halt, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Unlawful Overtaking or Passing of a Vehicle
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who overtakes or passes another motor vehicle in a double yellow line, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Interference with a Traffic Control Sign
records.text: Any person who stands on, sits on, hinders, or obstructs any traffic control sign with their body, or another vehicle, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Interference with a Traffic Control Device
records.text: Any person who stands on, sits on, hinders, or obstructs any traffic control device with their body, or another vehicle, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Noise Pollution
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who uses a horn, brake feature, car engine, or any other vehicular function to disturb the peace through excessive noise shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Disabled Vehicles Obstructing Traffic
records.text: Whenever a vehicle is disabled on any street or highway within the state or for any reason obstructs the regular flow of traffic, the driver shall move the vehicle so as not to obstruct the regular flow of traffic or, if he or she cannot move the vehicle alone, solicit help and move the vehicle so as not to obstruct the regular flow of traffic. Any person failing to do so shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Dangerous Lane Change
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle that changes lanes designated for motor vehicles in a manner that a reasonable person would deem unsafe, or without signaling the change at least 3 seconds prior will be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Unauthorized Access to a Bridge
records.text: Any person who accesses or climbs onto the lower or upper trusses, suspenders, piers, decking, or any non-designated walkway, roadway, or median area of a bridge—without being an authorized employee of the Port Authority of Mayflower and Quanahassit, an approved maintenance worker from a government agency or contracted company, or having explicit permission from the Port Authority, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Obstruction of a Tunnel or Bridge
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle who intentionally prevents, or reasonably could prevent vehicles from passing freely along a tunnel or bridge, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Failure to Yield to Stopped Emergency Vehicles
records.text: Any operator of a motor vehicle approaching a stationary authorized emergency vehicle or public service vehicle that is stopped within 20 studs of a roadway with activated warning and/or hazards lights, who fails to completely move the vehicle into a lane that is not adjacent to the emergency vehicle when traveling on a roadway with two or more lanes in the same direction and when such movement can be made with due regard for safety and traffic conditions, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Jaywalking
records.text: Any pedestrian who crosses a roadway not on a designated crossing or crosswalk fitted with a traffic control device which is signalling red for the pedestrian or where the pedestrian could reasonably have used a designated crosswalk unless there is no on-coming traffic within a distance where the pedestrian can walk across to the opposite side of the street without traffic coming within 50 studs of their person until they have fully crossed the street shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 1. CRIMES RELATING TO MOTOR VEHICLES

records.heading: Operating a Class IV Motor Vehicle outside of Designated Hours (1-3am)
records.text: Inactive statute
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 2. CRIMES RELATING TO COMMERCIAL VEHICLES

records.heading: Operating a Commercial Vehicle without a CDL
records.text: Any person who drives a commercial vehicle designated by law, without a valid commercial drivers license issued by the state, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 2. CRIMES RELATING TO COMMERCIAL VEHICLES

records.heading: Driving in a No-Commercial-Vehicle Zone
records.text: Any individual who operates a vehicle in a no-commercial-vehicle zone shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 2. CRIMES RELATING TO COMMERCIAL VEHICLES

records.heading: Operating a Commercial Vehicle within the Left Lane
records.text: Any person who operates a commercial vehicle with a gross weight rating exceeding five-hundred (500) units, within the leftmost lane on a state highway or public roadway with two or more lanes traveling in one direction, without meeting the exceptions pursuant to 6 M.S.C. 4 § 2205, shall be guilty of an infraction.
records.subtitle: SUBTITLE 2. CRIMES RELATING TO COMMERCIAL VEHICLES
